SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_FinancialProduct_DID] AS
BEGIN
WITH TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct AS
(
	SELECT
		BDP.PRODUCT_TYPE AS FinancialProductId
		,BDP.PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION AS FinancialProductName
		,BDP.BANK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,BDP.SOURCE_CODE AS SourceCode
		,BDP.PRODUCT_GROUP AS ProductGrouping
		,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BDP.insert_dttm AS InsertDttm
		--,'INSERT' RECORD_STATUS
	FROM  BUSC.DID_PRODUCTGROUPING BDP
	WHERE BDP.ISLATEST = 1 AND BDP.SOURCE_CODE IN ('CCD')

    UNION ALL

    	SELECT
		BDP.PRODUCT_TYPE AS FinancialProductId
		,BDP.PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION AS FinancialProductName
		,BDP.BANK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,BDP.SOURCE_CODE AS SourceCode
		,BDP.PRODUCT_GROUP AS ProductGrouping
		,'SEC' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BDP.insert_dttm AS InsertDttm
		--,'INSERT' RECORD_STATUS
	FROM  BUSC.DID_PRODUCTGROUPING BDP
	WHERE BDP.ISLATEST = 1 AND BDP.SOURCE_CODE IN ('SEC')

)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct FROM TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct;

WITH TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_SRC AS
(
	SELECT
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
			FinancialProductId
			,FinancialProductName
			,FinancialInstitutionId
			,SourceCode
			,ProductGrouping)) AS HASHROW
		,FinancialProductId ,FinancialInstitutionId --,RECORD_STATUS
	FROM #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct --WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
),

TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_TGT AS
(
	SELECT
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
			FinancialProductId
			,FinancialProductName
			,FinancialInstitutionId
			,SourceCode
			,ProductGrouping)) AS HASHROW
		,FinancialProductId 
	FROM BNKM.FinancialProduct WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DID'
),

TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_DELTA AS
(
	SELECT	
		SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
		,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialProductId,TGT.FinancialProductId) AS FinancialProductId
		,CASE
			WHEN TGT.FinancialProductId  IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
			WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
			ELSE NULL 
		END AS RECORD_STATUS
	FROM TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_SRC SRC
	LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_TGT TGT
	 ON SRC.FinancialProductId = TGT.FinancialProductId
	WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT
SET
	FinancialProductId = SRC.FinancialProductId
	,FinancialProductName = SRC.FinancialProductName
	,FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,SourceCode = SRC.SourceCode
	,ProductGrouping = SRC.ProductGrouping
	,SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode
	,TaskRunId = SRC.TaskRunId
	,WorkFlowId = SRC.WorkFlowId
	,InsertDttm = SRC.InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.FinancialProduct TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_DELTA DELTA
	ON DELTA.FinancialProductId = TGT.FinancialProductId
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct SRC
	ON SRC.FinancialProductId = TGT.FinancialProductId

INSERT INTO BNKM.FinancialProduct 
	(FinancialProductId
	,FinancialProductName
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,SourceCode
	,ProductGrouping
	,SourceSystemCode
	,TaskRunId
	,WorkFlowId
	,InsertDttm)
SELECT
	SRC.FinancialProductId
	,FinancialProductName
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,SourceCode
	,ProductGrouping
	,SourceSystemCode
	,TaskRunId
	,WorkFlowId
	,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.FinancialProductId = SRC.FinancialProductId 
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_DELTA;

END
GO
